caption: The poster title: how to play, the dangers of the court, the four watches and the seasons — the whole game on one screen.
Between watches, choose 1 of 3 Shadow Gifts; two of one family wake its synergy.
Dusk: the sun drifts on its own and the shade-road shrinks — cross while the long shadows last.
Night: the Great Sunwraith sweeps its burning gaze across the court. Time your crossing between sweeps.
